messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: part:340010 – firm long-term commitment for the full seal volume
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quote and for explaining the capacity situation.

Our orders with you for part:340010 rose from EUR 28.94 (po:4500010364-10) to EUR 29.89 (po:4500010407-10) between 2023-12-27 and 2024-01-05. That rise is already in our price. Our should-cost estimate for part:340010 is EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010), below your price. The forecast for part:340010 increased by 10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

You wrote that you prioritise firm, long-term commitments. The attached packages offer exactly that: a binding commitment for our full annual volume over several years. This gives you planning security for your capacity.

What is the earliest lead time you can confirm?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:340010 – firm long-term commitment for the full seal volume
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

We have reviewed your data and can offer EUR 31.50 for 23,400 units over 24 months. Our current Angebot comprises a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. A lead time of 56 days is the earliest we can confirm without applying a substantial premium. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: part:340010 - revised packages for 24-month full-volume commitment
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised offer and for confirming the data we sent.

We have moved our price toward yours in both attached packages. Each covers our full annual volume over 24 months. You wrote on 2026-09-18 that you prioritise firm, long-term commitments, and this gives your capacity planning a fixed, even call-off base. The first package keeps your 56-day lead time. The second offers a shorter lead time against a higher price, if that suits your scheduling.

As price changes of this size go to your pricing committee, could you please put these packages to it at its next meeting?

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:340010 - revised packages for 24-month full-volume commitment
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your revised packages and note the minor price adjustment. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We can offer a price of €31.40 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. 

Please provide concrete data to substantiate your claim regarding a fixed, even call-off base before we consider any internal meetings. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: Re: part:340010 - revised packages for 24-month full-volume commitment
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
